name: Langwill
summary: Shopify translation and currency app (formerly ETranslate) with AI translation, geolocation redirects and multilingual SEO; a free plan covers 5,000 words in one language.
best_for: Shopify merchants who want their store in several languages and currencies without hiring translators, and who can start on a free or $9.99 plan
skip_if: your catalogue needs more than 20 languages or far above 300,000 words a month, you want human-checked translation included, or you want a tool we have tested ourselves
honest_knock: Plans are capped by words a month, and extra words cost $9.99 per 30,000, so a large catalogue gets pricey. Auto-translate and image translation need Growth, and GPT-4 translation needs Premium. Even Premium covers 20 languages. We have not installed it, so translation quality and speed impact are unknown to us.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per month for 30,000 words and 10 languages
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-18 on the Shopify App Store listing, US dollars, billed every 30 days) Free: 5,000 words, 1 translated language, 153 currencies, multilingual SEO. Starter: $9.99 a month, 30,000 words a month, 10 languages, glossary, automatic currency switching. Growth: $19.99 a month, 80,000 words a month, 20 languages, auto-translate, image translation. Premium: $49.99 a month, 300,000 words a month, 20 languages, GPT-4 translation, extra words $9.99 per 30,000. Paid plans list a 3-day free trial. We have not paid for a plan.

sessions.what: Our AI assistant ran the test on 21 November 2026 on a Shopify development store with the interface in English. We installed the app, added German, enabled the app embed in the theme and opened a translated product page in the theme preview. About 3.5 minutes passed between pressing Install and the German page. We stayed on the free plan and paid nothing. LangShop was installed in the same store for a separate test and later overwrote these German product translations.
findings: Install: the Shopify dialog asked for staff and contributor data and for view and edit access to products, the Online Store and the Shopify admin.
Setup: the app opens on a three step wizard: choose languages, set a currency format and enable the app embed. We skipped the currency step because it asks you to paste HTML into the store settings.
Translation: German sat on "Homepage SEO Waiting..." for about 1.5 minutes, then read "Translated" after a reload. The publish switch was off until we turned it on.

Result: the theme preview of a product page showed it in German, with "In den Warenkorb legen" and a language switcher set to Deutsch. Clicking Deutsch in the switcher inside the editor did nothing at first.

Plans: the app lists Starter $9.99, Growth $19.99 and Premium $49.99 a month in credits, while the App Store listing counts words and puts multilingual SEO in the free plan. After one language our free plan read "1 languages limit Reached."
not_tested: Not tested: the paid plans. The Starter approval screen showed a real $9.99 charge after a 3 day trial and no test charge note, so we did not approve it.
Not tested: currency formats, redirect by location, translated SEO fields and URLs, a second language, GPT 4 or DeepL translation, image translation and the public storefront.
sessions.note: Findings as written up after the session; no pass/fail per task was scored.
